_comment: Upgrade policy published with every release as template-policy.json (2026-10-09 approval, project-upgrade-button). minimum_supported is the oldest release MakeItOurs still accepts requests for (a release tag such as v0.1.0.40), or null for no gate: projects behind the latest release are asked to upgrade, and projects below minimum_supported must upgrade first. Raise it in a reviewed commit; the next release publishes it.
message: Upgrade this project to the latest MakeItOurs template to keep building and publishing.
